facts: Step definitions live in classes that implement `Behat\Behat\Context\Context` and declare their patterns in DOCBLOCK annotations: `/** @Given /^regex$/ */`, `@When`, `@Then`. Plain-text patterns (`@Given I am logged in as :email`) also work. The Given/When/Then keyword is irrelevant to matching.
Argument transforms use `/** @Transform /^regex$/ */` methods on a context class and convert a captured string into an object.
The scenario's `Background` steps run before it and need definitions too.

Contexts are Symfony services. The harness registers every class you return as `public`, `autowired` and `autoconfigured`. If a constructor argument cannot be autowired (CoreShop wires many collaborators by service id, e.g. `@coreshop.repository.product`, `@coreshop.factory.product`, `@coreshop.behat.shared_storage`), return an extra file named `behat_services.yml` containing a Symfony `services:` block with explicit `arguments:` for your classes.
`CoreShop\Bundle\TestBundle\Service\SharedStorageInterface` is the shared clipboard between steps (`->set($key, $value)`, `->get($key)`).

Production namespaces are `CoreShop\Component\*` and `CoreShop\Bundle\*`. Put your classes under `src/CoreShop/Behat/Context/Domain/**`, creating missing directories. Custom hook classes may use that directory too. `src/CoreShop/Behat/Context/Hook/` is retained infrastructure: files created or changed anywhere in that subtree are not submitted.

This workspace supports reading, searching, editing, and syntax parsing. It is a provisioned application runtime for the code in `./repo`; nothing here is executed by the harness. The harness executes your final submitted test artifacts against a separate, complete implementation after generation ends. You receive no harness execution feedback during generation.
TARGET_CONTRACTS.md contains the reviewed public API and configuration supplement supplied in every visibility view. It is context for writing tests; edits to it are not submitted.
Implementation visibility: the reviewed target bodies, including behavior-bearing delegated helpers, are hidden; declarations and permitted surrounding implementations remain visible.
environment.platform: the CoreShop e-commerce platform (PHP 8.3, Symfony, Pimcore)
environment.run: `behat-scenario <feature file>:<line>` runs one Scenario in this workspace.

rules: Only files under `repo/src/CoreShop/Behat/` are accepted. Repo-wide removal deleted those directories, so create whatever path you need; `Context/Hook` and its entire subtree remain as reserved infrastructure and are excluded from submission.
Production code is never accepted. Anything you change outside `repo/src/CoreShop/Behat/` is discarded.
If a constructor argument cannot be autowired, a file `repo/behat_services.yml` is read as a Symfony `services:` block for your classes.

Scenario: Create a new currency for country US
    Given the site has a currency "USD" with iso "USD"
    And the site has a country "USA" with currency "USD"
    And the currency has a exchange-rate to currency "EUR" of "1.1"
    Then price "100" of currency "USD" should exchange to price "110" in currency "EUR"
    Then price "100" of currency "EUR" should exchange to price "91" in currency "USD"
